headline: Paraquat banned, a new import-for-export route, twin-pack guidelines, the Indoxacarb isomer rule, NJSP in place of judicial stamp paper, and a large clean-up of old files.

changes.d: Unregistered pesticides may be imported from any source only for export. Approval in about 3 months; certificate valid 1 year or until the product is registered in India. Registered molecules still need a confirmed order. Public comments invited by notice of 23.11.2026, within 30 days.

S.O. 5234(E) of 22.09.2026 prohibits it; registrations are cancelled. HPMA members covered by the Punjab & Haryana High Court order of 14.10.2026 are not to be called back for now. Pending Paraquat files are rejected or closed.
Two or more registered products may be sold in one pack only where that combination formulation is itself registered. Surfactant-pack guidelines too. Draft open for public comments for 30 days.

changes.t: Indoxacarb: isomer ratio on every product
changes.d: Composition, specification and method of analysis must show total Indoxacarb, the active S-isomer, the inactive R-isomer and their ratio (e.g. 14.5% SC reads 19.43% total). Applies to new, pending and registered products; no separate endorsement needed. A public notice will follow.

changes.t: 9(4) certificates: KYC + original affidavit in 15 days
changes.d: Approved 9(4) cases get their certificate only after KYC and the original affidavit (439th RC format) reach CIB&RC within 15 days of the minutes being uploaded.
Undertakings must now be on NJSP e-stamp paper.
A D.O. letter will go from DA&FW to the states' Principal Secretaries to push the remaining applicants.

9(4) insecticide endorsements without a fixed MRL are closed; files with no reply, blank replies or delayed sampling are closed (31 in 9(4) TIM alone). A public notice (issued 18.11.2026) lists old pending files: reply within 30 days or the file closes.

changes.t: No fresh application on the same grounds after a rejection
changes.d: The RC called Indofil's second application on grounds already rejected 'concealment of facts' and called the company for a presentation.
A committee under ADG (PP), ICAR will set the route for approving nano pesticides; stakeholders may present to it.

changes.t: Household pest products without health monitoring
changes.d: Syngenta's Thiamethoxam + Lambda-cyhalothrin ZC label expansion approved without health monitoring studies: only trained Pest Control Operators may use it, not in hospitals, schools, Anganwadis or food areas.
Yashnee Agrochemicals sent a forged Aluminium Phosphide certificate to Ecuador; show-cause notice with 2 weeks to reply.

actions: 9(4) TI/TIM/FIM approval: send the original affidavit within 15 days and complete KYC.
Indoxacarb product: correct the composition and label when the public notice comes.
Old pending file: check the 18.11.2026 notice and reply within 30 days.
Undertakings: use NJSP from now on.
Export or twin-pack interest: send comments within 30 days of the notice.
